title: OpenACC II: loop optimization, asynchrony, and multiple devices
status: reviewed and locally validated; independent round 2 ACCEPT

review_history.finding: Routine specification locator corrected; pending round 2 review.

transcript_provenance: Local machine transcription (faster-whisper small.en); not publisher captions. All three complete transcripts read. Original frames checked; no allegation about unverified spoken wording.
source_uncertainties: Only one physical GPU was available. acc_device_partition.c executed devices=1, selected=1; every p>1 branch remains unexecuted. No multi-GPU speedup, peer-link or network experiment was performed.
Asynchronous image correctness was checked without a device timeline or overlap timing. No physical compute/transfer overlap or asynchronous speedup is claimed.
GCC13.3 reports _OPENACC=201711. Successful individual feature checks do not establish full OpenACC3.3/3.4 conformance.

W9L6 device_type slide f0046 displays collapse(3) for shared C[i][j] accumulation without a displayed reduction/atomic. The chapter diagnoses the displayed snippet using read/write ownership; no claim about unverified speech is made.

GCC13.3 online Enabling-OpenACC/OpenACC-Implementation-Status URLs could not be opened; they are not cited or relied upon. Actual compiler macro/output and accessible nvptx manual provide local support evidence.
The same scalar image routine supplies host and device results; elementwise parity tests offload/partition implementation, not an independent proof of Mandelbrot membership.
